source: projection_guidance_prompts.json screening subset; exploratory direction qualification, not confirmation

cases.prompt: A full-body documentary photograph of a bicycle courier kneeling to thread a chain through the rear derailleur at a curb. Show both shoes, one hand on the pedal and the other guiding the chain, rain-dark pavement, candid posture.
cases.alternate: A documentary photograph of a bicycle courier kneeling to thread a chain through the rear derailleur at a curb. One hand on the pedal and the other guiding the chain, rain-dark pavement, candid posture.
cases.primary_endpoint: Both shoes and the full body visible; retain hand-object contact and mechanically plausible bicycle parts.

cases.prompt: Macro product photograph of a scratched brass compass half-open on coarse indigo linen next to a fractured white shell. Distinguish the directional weave, shallow metal scratches and the shell's layered edge, subdued afternoon light.
cases.alternate: Macro product photograph of a scratched brass compass half-open on coarse indigo linen next to a fractured white shell. Subdued afternoon light.
cases.primary_endpoint: Distinct directional linen weave, metal scratches and shell layers; no spurious detail or oversharpening.

cases.prompt: A documentary photograph of a red kettle on the left end of a black workbench, a clear jar of screws directly behind the kettle, and a folded blue cloth on the far right. In a mirror above the bench the same objects appear in a consistent reflection.
cases.alternate: A documentary photograph of a red kettle on the left end of a black workbench, a clear jar of screws directly behind the kettle, and a folded blue cloth on the far right. A mirror hangs above the bench.
cases.primary_endpoint: Mirror reflection contains the same objects in geometrically consistent locations; retain the primary object arrangement.

qualification: Require identical input and conditioning fingerprints, repeat floor below half the realized edit RMS, and matched native-rounded target RMS within 10%. A declined intervention is a decline, not a successful control. Score candidate previews and final outputs separately, without arm metadata, against the predeclared primary endpoint and fidelity/regression criteria.
